assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Input1 is the exact existing scene EDIT TARGET: preserve its composition, story, gestures, camera, cast, identities, costumes, props and emotion. Input2 and input3 are USER-APPROVED finished R03/R04 illustrations and are the authoritative rich COLOR, EYES, LINE and CEL-SHADING references. Input4 is the shared body/silhouette model. Do not use or recreate any v18 no-shading / flat-icon reference.
Match the appealing Japanese anime faces with bold exaggerated Western TV cartoon anatomy and angular graphic sensibility of Panty & Stocking with Garterbelt seen in the approved images. VERY THICK crisp nearblack NAVY exterior outlines; thinner simpler descriptive face/clothing lines. Long straight runs, wedges, trapezoids, angular curves with decisive corners at jaw/hair/elbow/knee/collar/hems. Large head, compact short torso, elongated slender forearms/shins, narrow wrists/ankles, oversized expressive hands and substantial geometric thick-soled shoes. All figures share the same underlying3.5–4human-head model excluding ears/horns/hair/hat/bow; bent or seated poses do not become toddler proportions. Preserve the existing pose and expressive silhouette rather than turning this into a model lineup.
Eyes follow the APPROVED illustrations, not the old asset: Choa's green almond construction from R04, Isol amber/Tori blue/Yeoul rose from R03. Same face-relative eye size, thick graphic upper eyelid, wedge-like outer lash accents and slightly lifted corners across scenes; expressions change brows, lid opening, gaze and mouth without inventing a new eye shape. Simple iris/pupil colors with one crisp white glint; no elaborate rings/bands or excessive sparkle, no tiny icon eyes or dead doll eyes. Naturally closed laughter eyes remain closed. Human faces, small nose/mouth and human hands; animal details limited to ears/horns/tails.
Preserve VIVID original local colors and warm amber/orange/gold versus navy/blue/violet contrast. Each material uses broad clean flat BASE COLOR + ONE CLEAR, HARD-EDGED GEOMETRIC CEL SHADOW, optional small third accent step. Skin restrained warm-violet shadow, ivory fabric/white hair limited lavender shadow, blonde ochre shadow, orange burnt-orange shadow, blue navy-blue shadow, pink deeper rose shadow. Rich color must remain; NOT washed-out, muddy, monochrome or unshaded coloring-book art. Use larger intentional triangles/trapezoids, not many tiny disconnected facets on every fold. No airbrushed lighting, soft gradient domination, glossy volumetric skin, texture/noise/grain, painterly brushwork, glow/bloom, 3D or realistic anatomy. Background has the same angular construction with less detail/contrast than characters; preserve its original day/night state and architecture. No added ornaments/symbols, new objects, text/dialogue/UI/logo/watermark. One complete original9:16 portrait scene, no collage or comparison.

R01 SPECIFIC: Four friends at their tea gathering after festival. Keep Choa left, Isol middle-left laughing with naturally CLOSED eyes and arms raised, Tori middle-right pouring tea, Yeoul right resting her cheek on her hand. Exactly4cups,4saucers,1teapot, same chairs/table/pouring gesture. Keep gentle playful friend banter, not urgency. Same large floating-island night background/lantern and warm furniture colors. Do not open Isol's closed eyes merely to add irises.
assets.review: Viewed final native output. Rich orange/gold furniture and dress against navy/blue/violet retained; thick angular outer contours and large bounded cel-shadow planes match approved references. Four friends retain all poses; Isol naturally closed laughing eyes remain closed. Tori still pours the single teapot into the existing four-cup/four-saucer tea setting. No story or composition change; no must-fix findings.

Use case: surgical local image edit. Correct ONLY malformed extra fingers in INPUT1, retaining the exact original scene, camera, composition, character designs/expressions, costumes, gestures, body proportions, background, lighting and saturated palette. Keep the existing 9:16 vertical composition, do not crop any character or change the framing. All people have HUMAN hands with EXACTLY FIVE DIGITS TOTAL per hand: FOUR fingers and ONE opposable thumb. Four fingers emerge together from one side of the palm; thumb emerges separately from the side. No sixth spike, duplicated thumb, merged fingers, extra palm or disconnected wrist. Natural overlap/occlusion is allowed: hidden fingers remain hidden rather than forcing every digit visible. Draw hands as the same oversized angular expressive cartoon shapes, with crisp readable negative space and clear knuckles only where required.
STYLE LOCK: user's established Japanese anime face + bold Western TV cartoon/Panty & Stocking with Garterbelt graphic sensibility, thick crisp almost-black navy angular outlines, compact torso/elongated limbs/large hands and shoes, heavy wedge upper lashes/slightly upturned eye corners, rich vivid FLAT base areas with restrained hard-edged polygon CEL shadows, max2–3tones/material. Absolutely no style redesign, gradients, airbrush, painterly texture, 3D gloss or muted recoloring. Do not change faces, eyes, ages, anatomy outside the specified hands, costumes, architecture or storytelling. No text/UI/logos/watermarks. Opaque finished scene, no transparent background.
SCENE-SPECIFIC INVARIANTS: Audit and correct EACH open hand in the scene, especially the isolated boy ISOL inside the closed blue-gold barrier on image left (both palms), CHOA's outstretched hand near center-left, and YEOUL's raised hand AND her lower bracing hand. Each fully open palm has exactly FIVE fingertips: one thumb plus four fingers. Correct overcounted six-point starburst palms. Keep ISOL sealed INSIDE the unbroken translucent blue-gold chamber and all three friends OUTSIDE, with no contact or new opening. TORI still holds/supports CHOA from image right; preserve all arms and occlusions.
assets.review: Viewed final source hand silhouettes: human hand anatomy with four fingers plus one thumb, respecting hidden digits and original wrist/gesture. Scene composition and clothing retained. Isol remains inside the closed chamber; all friends remain outside.
